TRAIL-3 EVERY TICK · PER-PAIR: each pair's paper engine (trail-3 loss → random loss) fires its own live R1→R2→R3 · selected pair also trades live base

Configurations

Inputs and configuration changes are saved automatically on this device. Ready
ARM-THEN-RIDE: System A paper-trades the SAME trail-N every-tick strategy as the live BASE engine, on every selected pair. It fires R1 LIVE the moment the pair's run of consecutive trail-N paper-LOSSes reaches N (the selector above — 1, 2, or 3) — the exact loss signal the base engine produces. Once R1 is LIVE the cascade RIDES: an R1 LOSS fires R2 next tick, an R2 LOSS fires R3 next tick — no per-level re-gate. It runs R1→R2→R3 straight through until a WIN (full recovery) or R3 LOSS (writeoff), then the pair returns to base + paper-observe and must build a fresh N-streak to arm again.
(skip BASE actual fire; each tick spawns a paper observation. Only open a real cascade at entry level when paper BASE [and R1 if entry=R2] would have LOST.)
When TP hits and this is ON, ignore the timed rolling window — instead wait for a paper BASE→R1→R2→R3 LOSS chain (4 consecutive picker matches) on the live tick stream, then auto-resume with a fresh PnL baseline.
Freeze ALL fires after N consecutive picker LOSSes; resume after M consecutive picker WINs. Cascade state survives the freeze.
Sliding-window cap on ALL outgoing API calls (buys + POC subs + occasional polls). Default 55 stays 5 below Deriv's ~60-req/min hard cap. Each new BASE reserves 2 slots (1 buy + 1 subscribe). With POC streaming now used on PAT too, expect ~25-27 live trades/min on 1Hz pairs — close to the 30/min cap that R_25 pairs naturally produce.
Toggle System A on/off. When ON, each pair runs the trail-N paper engine and fires its own random R1/R2/R3 recovery. When OFF, System A never fires (you can run System B alone). The main pair always trades live base regardless.
Deep pool (paper-trades the trail-N strategy in parallel · the FIRST pair to reach the awaited level's BtB fires the recovery LIVE · the main pair is included in the race):
When the main pair loses at any diverted level, the cascade waits (forever) for the pool. Each selected pair is already paper-trading the same trail-N strategy in parallel; the FIRST pair whose consecutive paper-LOSS streak meets the awaited level's BtB threshold (R1=2/R2=3/R3=4) fires that recovery LIVE on itself (barrier = its current trail-N pick, stake = autoStake on the accumulated debt). Because streaks are never reset, a pair already at threshold fires the instant the level is armed. POC settles back onto the original cascade, which then advances to the next level (also via the pool) on a loss, or closes on a win.
DEEP-POOL ACTIVE: orig pair — debt $0.00
Runs on all 17 pairs in parallel with System A. Per pair, a 10s cycle paper-trades the COLDEST digit (least frequent over lookback). After N consecutive coldest paper-LOSSes → fire R1 LIVE on the coldest digit; R1 loss → R2 coldest next cycle → R3 → writeoff. One coldest-recovery per pair; can run alongside an active System-A recovery on the same pair.
Identical architecture to System B but fires the HOTTEST digit (most frequent over lookback). Per pair, a 10s cycle paper-trades the hottest digit; after N consecutive hottest paper-LOSSes → fire R1 LIVE on the hottest digit; R1 loss → R2 hottest next cycle → R3 → writeoff. One hottest-recovery per pair; runs alongside System A and System B on the same pair. (Statistically performs the same as coldest — both ~10% loss.)
EVERY TICK, watches each pair's CURRENT digit back-to-back repeat run. When the SAME digit prints R1 times in a row → fire R1 LIVE differ-on-that-digit; the run reaching R2 → R2; R3 → R3; run R3+1 → writeoff. Global thresholds (default 7/8/9 — from the digit-repeat backtest, worst run = 9, so R3 fires at the worst and only writes off BEYOND it). One repeat-recovery per pair; shares the one-at-a-time recovery lock with A/B/C; clears pooled base losses like B/C.
Per pair, runs BOTH strategies — FURTHEST (9 if streak-digit ≤4 else 0) and NEIGHBOR (adjacent) — across EVERY viable trigger (2x/3x/4x/5x), each (strategy × trigger) its own cascade lane with its OWN arm = max(1, maxBtB−3) from the full-year backtest (table E_CFG). On a lane's Nx repeat trigger it paper-bets DIGITDIFF; after that lane's arm in consecutive paper trigger-LOSSes → R1 LIVE on the next trigger; R1 loss → R2 → R3 → writeoff. Triggers with historical max-BtB ≥ 6 are ELIMINATED (41 of 160 combos). All lanes share the one-at-a-time lock + clear pooled base losses. Arm override = 0 uses the per-trigger arms; set >0 to force one arm everywhere. Edit E_CFG to retune.
Ports the full digit-research-lab (50 families × 10 = 500 gated strategies — the original 200 F-families + 300 G-families merged from drl_session_2026-06-11) as recovery signals on every pair. Each (pair × strategy) paper-observes its DIGITDIFF signal; after its own arm = max(2, maxBtB−3) consecutive paper LOSSes (from the full-year 567M-tick backtest, table F_MAXBTB) → R1 LIVE on the strategy's target → R2/R3 → writeoff. Shares the one-at-a-time lock + clears pooled base losses like A–E. ~200×17 lanes run every tick. OFF by default — validate in Paper mode before LIVE.
A SECOND, independent 500-strategy recovery lane running in PARALLEL with System F — do NOT confuse with F. Ports the 500 brand-new-family DIGITDIFF strategies (NA001–NA500, 50 structurally-new families: arithmetic, digital-root, gap, Markov, positional-sequence, parity-runs, complement, cross-scale, second-order, bitwise, order-stat) from differ_500_NEW_maxbtb_livetest.html. Each (pair × strategy) paper-observes its DIGITDIFF signal; after its OWN per-strategy arm = its measured max_b2b (from differ500_new_maxbtb CSV: arm4×195, arm5×269, arm6×33, arm7×2, arm8×1) consecutive paper LOSSes → R1 LIVE on the strategy's target → R2 → R3 → writeoff. Shares the same debt-pool + one-at-a-time lock + cascade as A–F (system tag F2). Continuously shadow-tracks every (strategy,pair) true b2b for later arm auto-calibration. 500×17 lanes run every tick, on top of F.
Per pair, runs a 2-, 3- and 4-digit GENUINE-cycle detector every tick (imported from live_pattern_break_recovery_234). When a K-cycle repeats ≥ trigger times (trigger = pair's per-length base + the shift above, floored at 2) it fires DIGITDIFF ≠ the digit that would continue the cycle; R1 loss → R2 (differ the next continuing digit) → R3 → writeoff. All three lengths (L2/L3/L4) active. Clears pooled base losses + shares the one-at-a-time recovery lock like A–F.
Faithful port of perpair_safearm_r3_after_worst. Each pair carries its historical worst back-to-back streak M (per-digit 10s max-BtB: Vol10/75/100=7, Vol25/50=8, R_100/Bull/Bear=6, Jumps 7–8). Every cycle samples one digit and tracks the streaking run; at run M−2 (with a pooled base loss waiting) it fires DIGITDIFF ≠ the streaking digit; an R1/R2 loss = that digit printed again (run deepened) → R2 (run M−1) → R3 (run M); an R3 loss = run passed the pair's worst-ever M → writeoff. Per-pair M, pool-gated, shares the one-at-a-time lock like A–G.
Port of trail1_revisit. Trail-1 base = DIGITDIFF on the current digit, so a loss = a digit X repeated. After X goes away then revisits (reprints), each reappearance is another back-to-back loss. At the R1 trigger (default 2: fire R1 after 2 back-to-back; R2 after 3, R3 after 4) it fires DIGITDIFF ≠ X to clear a pooled base loss; R1 loss → R2 on the next tick → R3 → writeoff (the revisit pattern is the entry trigger only; the ride is immediate so it never stalls the lock). R1 trigger live-editable. Pool-gated, shares the one-at-a-time lock like A–H.
Port of trail_current_pause_on_repeat (T=1). Each tick paper-bets DIGITDIFF ≠ the previous digit; a loss = the ABA gap-2 echo (dK=dK-2). Pause-on-repeat + cool-down(3) + paper-arm(3) gate the genuine back-to-back count exactly as the full-year stress did. R1 fires at maxBtB−2 per pair (from the year-long FILTERED stress, J_MAXBTB), R2/R3 ride live; writeoff lands at maxBtB+1 — above the year's worst → write-off-proof. e.g. 1HZ75V maxBtB 6 → R1 after 4, R3 after 6; most pairs maxBtB 4 → R1 after 2, R3 after 4. The R1 trigger dropdown shifts every pair's trigger live (−1 = fire one loss earlier / R3 below the worst; +1/+2 = later / R3 above it) — the per-pair maxBtB spread is preserved, just slid. Auto-bump-aware (per-pair +1 on R3), shares the one-at-a-time lock like A–I.
Port of trail4_btb_finder. Each tick paper-bets DIGITDIFF ≠ the digit 4 ticks back; a loss = that digit reprints (dK=dK-4). Consecutive losses arm the ladder: default R1 after 2 back-to-back, R2 after 3, R3 after 4, writeoff after 5 — above the 70-min finder's global max BtB (4) → write-off-proof (most pairs maxed at 3; R_25/JD10/RDBULL at 4). R1 trigger live-editable; R2=+1, R3=+2. Auto-bump-aware (+1 on R3), shares the one-at-a-time lock like A–J.
Raw port of multipair_scalper_PAT — no training phase, no win-rate gate, no slots, just the engine. Each tick paper-bets DIGITDIFF ≠ the coldest digit of the last 5 ticks (least-frequent; lowest digit wins ties); a loss = that cold digit prints next. Consecutive losses arm the ladder: default R1 after 3 back-to-back, R2 after 4, R3 after 5, writeoff after 6 — above the 400k-trade CSV global max BtB (5) → write-off-proof (most pairs maxed at 4; 1HZ10V/JD50 at 5). R1 trigger live-editable; R2=+1, R3=+2. Auto-bump-aware (+1 on R3), shares the one-at-a-time lock like A–K.
Mirror of System L, flipped to the hottest digit of the last 5 ticks (most-frequent; lowest wins ties); a loss = that hot digit prints next. Same raw engine — no training/win-rate/slots. Default R1 after 3, R2 after 4, R3 after 5 (same as L). ⚠ Real-data check (3M ticks/pair): hot-5 maxBtB is 6–7 (higher than cold-5's 5 — the hot digit reprints more), so at trigger 3 there's a small writeoff tail; set trigger 5 (R3 at 7, writeoff at 8) for write-off-proof. R1 trigger live-editable; R2=+1, R3=+2. Auto-bump-aware (+1 on R3), shares the one-at-a-time lock like A–L.
Port of winflip_R1R2_v2_parallel — everything enabled except the 🧠 Smart R2 Controller (not ported, per spec). Paper-bets DIGITDIFF ≠ the coldest digit of the last 20, gated by the universal safety filter: skip unless the cold digit (a) did NOT appear in the last N ticks (BASE/R1 5, R2 10, R3 20), (b) no digit clustered >6× in last 30, (c) the coldest didn't shift between prior-10 and new-10. The filter keeps streaks short — the live CSV showed max consec loss only 3 (1 R3, 0 writeoffs). Default R1 after 1 loss, R2 after 2, R3 after 3, writeoff after 4 (above the observed max → write-off-safe). On the R2/R3 ride it prefers a filter-safe cold digit, falling back to the plain coldest so the lock never stalls. R1 trigger live-editable. Auto-bump-aware (+1 on R3), shares the one-at-a-time lock like A–M.
Works like the standalone staggered_recovery_fleet: the 16 clean pairs run in parallel (1HZ25V excluded — corrupt data), each its own engine on its own cycle (default 5s). EXEMPT from the global one-at-a-time lock (A–N stay serial; O excluded from their count) so every pair can clear a pooled loss simultaneously. R1 trigger 0 = fire on the coldest-of-W confirmation immediately (current default); set 1/2/3 to require that many back-to-back cold-digit losses first. Fleet BASE = our R1; rides R2→R3 on losses, clearing on a win or writing off past R3. ON by default. Shares the pool + cap + R3-stagger + relay like A–N. A third parallel fleet identical to System O (coldest-of-W) but phase-shifted ⅓ of a cycle — O fires at phase 0, P at ½, O2 at ⅓ — so three fleets interleave and drain the pool on different beats. Reuses O's window / cycle / trigger settings; own state + own cascades; exempt from the serial lock like O/P/Q/R. ON. ⚠ It adds a 3rd stream of live fires — keep recFireGap and the parallel cap tuned so total fires stay under Deriv's ~60/min rate limit.
The HOT mirror of System O: same 16-pair parallel fleet engine, but bets DIGITDIFF ≠ the HOTTEST digit of the last W instead of the coldest. Phase-shifted ½ a cycle from O so cold (O) and hot (P) interleave in time. Runs parallel + exempt from the serial lock — so it's distinct from the existing serial System B (COLD) / C (HOT) countdowns. Fires R1 after BASE BTB hot reprints, re-gates R2/R3 on the deeper streak, clears the pool on a win or writes off past R3. OFF by default (it's the harder contrarian bet — test it first). Shares the pool + cap + R3-stagger + relay like A–O.
A longer-timeframe sibling of System O/P: same parallel, pool-driven engine, but picks the cold OR hot digit over a bigger window on a slow cycle (default 30s) — intentionally decorrelated from O/P's ~5s. Fires R1 on confirmation (R1 trigger 0; auto-bump raises it on pairs that keep reaching R3), then R1→R2→R3 fast-track on the next cycle at full stake. Shares the pool + cap + R3-stagger + ONE-R3-GLOBAL + relay like A–P. OFF by default — set the cycle to your backtested winning timeframe, then enable.
A parallel pool-driven recovery: bets DIGITDIFF on the nearest corner (0-4→0, 5-9→9) of a repeating digit. While a digit repeats for at least min run ticks it paper-observes the corner-differ; after R1 trigger consecutive corner losses it fires R1 to clear a pooled loss, then rides R1→R2→R3 on the next repeats. auto-bump self-calibrates the trigger per pair. Shares the pool + cap + R3-stagger + relay like A–Q. OFF by default.
current bumps: (none yet) Two-layer pool drain (both ON with this box): (1) parallel — up to 2 recovery cascades run at once at R1/R2 (R3 on its own independent track, never blocks R1/R2). (2) duplicate-clear — whenever the pool is ≥ the $ threshold, each R1 fires for TWO pooled losses (one bet sized to cover both) so each fire clears 2 → pool drains 2× while it's high, continuously, until it falls back under the threshold. R3 itself never multi-claims. ⚠ Tune the threshold to your base stake: at base $1, $5 = 5 losses and a 2-loss R3 ≈ $2.7k (safe under the $15k cap); at higher base, raise the cap or keep the threshold so a 2-loss R3 stays under cap. Untick to revert to strict one-at-a-time, one-loss-per-fire. When ON, ANY recovery system that fires a trade at R3 has its entry ARM ratcheted +1 (fires later / deeper into the loss cluster), so a cluster that reached R3 next time tops out at R2 — the frequency of reaching R3 falls over the session (max +5 per system). Maps to each system's own arm: A safety, B/C BtB, D run, E arm, F safety, G trigger. Turn OFF to revert instantly to your manual settings.
